mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, token, token_expire_time, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{token}, #{tokenExpireTime}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, token, token_expire_time, created_at, updated_at FROM users ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT id, username, token, token_expire_time, created_at, updated_at FROM users ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, username, token, token_expire_time, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE token = #{token} AND token_expire_time > NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET token = NULL, token_expire_time = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE token = #{token}
